title: Space Propulsion Analysis and Design, 1st ed. (revised)
authors: Ronald W. Humble, Gary N. Henry and Wiley J. Larson (eds.)
pdf_stem: Space Propulsion Analysis and Design by Ronald W. Humble (z-lib.org)

chapters.title: Solid Rocket Motors
chapters.why: solid-motor design process, sizing of case, igniter, insulation, nozzle and TVC; propellant and burning rate; performance prediction by lumped-parameter and spatial-pressure ballistics; a full case study
chapters.notes: pairs Sutton ch. 12-15 and H&P 12.6-12.7; case study 6.6 is the SRM golden vector

chapters.title: Liquid Rocket Propulsion Systems
chapters.why: preliminary design decisions, pressure budget, tank sizing, thrust chamber, feed system, turbomachinery, pressurization; case study
chapters.notes: pairs Sutton ch. 6 and Huzel ch. 4-6; case study 5.5 is an LRE golden vector

chapters.title: Thermochemistry
chapters.why: heats of formation, equilibrium-constant and free-energy-minimization methods, flame temperature, kinetics overview
chapters.notes: pairs Sutton ch. 5, H&P 2.4, Turns ch. 2

chapters.title: Thermodynamics of Fluid Flow
chapters.why: control-volume first law, isentropic flow, thrust equation, C_F and c*, heat addition, conduction, convection, radiation; cold-gas thruster example
chapters.notes: pairs Sutton ch. 3 and H&P ch. 3

chapters.title: Mission Analysis
chapters.why: orbits, perturbations, maneuvers, Earth-to-orbit velocity budget, staging, launch-vehicle steering, flight-simulation programs

chapters.title: Thermochemical Data for Selected Propellants (Appendix B)
Mission Design Case Study
chapters.why: end-to-end propulsion selection for a mission
